correctness.rationale: For 0<a<1 the time map has strictly positive derivative rho=(T/2)(1-a cos(2pi(sigma-c))). The physical slew rate of affine pseudotime u=u0+K tau is |K|/rho; saturating the tightest nodal inequality yields exactly (1-a max_node cos(2pi(s-c)))/(1-a). The closest circular node distance increases to half the largest cyclic gap at its midpoint, hence the sharp worst-phase (1-a cos(pi*g))/(1-a). All N cyclic gaps sum to one, so g>=1/N uniquely for equally spaced phases. For the two-point right Radau mesh normalized nodes {0,1/3}, g=2/3 and amplitude a=9/10 gives 29/2. The stated ceiling sample-count, N^-2 expansion and endpoint domain follow by solving this formula. Verified independent numeric mesh instances and exact rational Radau witness; no finite check replaces this proof.
